profiles.title: The Intelligent Adapts to Situations
profiles.description: The Intelligent Adapts to Situations. Witness tradition (10): and so a man of reason creates for every such instance a judgment and prepares resources for that accordingly, when he covets that which the enemy has to offer after being disappointed at what the friend couldn’t offer]. A man
openingHints: وذوى الرأي والعقل يهيّئ لكلّ ما حدث من ذلك رأيًا من الطبع فيما يحدث
so a man of reason and intelligence prepares for all such arising events a
وذو الرأي يحدث لكلّ ما يحدث رأيًا جديدًا أمّا من قبل العدوّ فبالبأس وأمّا
and so a man of reason creates for whatever happens a new judgment: for
وذو الرأي يحدث لكلّ حادث من ذلك رأيًا ويعدّ له عدّته عند الطمع فيما
and so a man of reason creates for every such instance a judgment and

witnessExcerpts.excerpt: وذوى الرأي والعقل يهيّئ لكلّ ما حدث من ذلك رأيًا من الطبع فيما يحدث من ذلك قبل العدوّ ولا بأس فيما عند الصديق
so a man of reason and intelligence prepares for all such arising events a natural judgment regarding that which ensues with an enemy-and there is no issue with the feelings of a friend.
وذو الرأي يحدث لكلّ ما يحدث رأيًا جديدًا أمّا من قبل العدوّ فبالبأس وأمّا من قبل الصديق فبالاستئناس
and so a man of reason creates for whatever happens a new judgment: for that which comes from the enemy, he uses boldness; and for that which comes from friends, he fosters intimacy.
وذو الرأي يحدث لكلّ حادث من ذلك رأيًا ويعدّ له عدّته عند الطمع فيما قبل العدوّ واليأس بما عند الصديق

and so a man of reason creates for every such instance a judgment and prepares resources for that accordingly, when he covets that which the enemy has to offer after being disappointed at what the friend couldn’t offer].
فذو الرأي يتحرّك لكلّ ما يطرأ عليه من ذلك عملًا من الطبع فيما قبل العدوّ
and so a man of reason adapts to all such arising changes acting upon the character of the enemy before him.
والعالم هو الذي يصير عند الاضطرار إلى مصادقة أعدائه والذي لا يعلم تسنّد عنه الوجوه في ذلك ولا يعرف له سببًا ولا وجهًا حتّى يهلك في العماء

The man of knowledge proceeds, when compelled, to befriend his enemies. And he who doesn’t know looses his way of things; and he recognizes neither motive nor direction until he perishes in blindness.

and so a man of reason adapts to all such arising changes acting upon the character of the enemy before him.
والعالم هو الذي يصير عند الاضطرار إلى مصادقة أعدائه والذي لا يعلم تسنّد عنه الوجوه في ذلك ولا يعرف له سببًا ولا وجهًا حتّى يهلك في العماء

The man of knowledge proceeds, when compelled, to befriend his enemies. And he who doesn’t know looses his way of things; and he recognizes neither motive nor direction until he perishes in blindness.

profiles.title: The Cat Is Caught
profiles.description: The Cat Is Caught. Witness tradition (12): وكانوا قُنّاص تلك البلد كلّ يوم يلتمسوا الأوديّة والمواضع ليلتقوا لهم صيدًا لينتفعوا به فلمّا كان بعض الأيّام مرّوا بتلك الشجرة فوجدوا الطير والوحش يأوي إليها فصاروا يلتزمون ذلك المكان في كلّ وقت [[وكلّ ما]] قال فلمّا كان بعض الأيّام جاء رجل منهم فنصب حباله فوقع فيها ذلك السنّور الذي اسمه رومي قال وكان لمّا وقع السنّور

profiles.title: The Rat Seeks Food
profiles.description: The Rat Seeks Food. Witness tradition (12): the rat was coming out to seek some nourishment. Upon seeing the cat in the snares, he became afraid for himself, turning left and right. Then saw the cat in the snares and rejoiced greatly at that, as if he fell upon an opportunity.

“The rat came out wanting to eat something, yet all the while cautious, turning
خرج الجرذ يلتمس له شيئًا يقتات به وصار الجرد لمّا رأى السنّور في الحبائل
the rat was coming out to seek some nourishment. Upon seeing the cat in
فخرج الجرذ يدبّ ويبغي ما يأكل وهو حذر من روميّ فبينما هو يسعى إذ
rat came out creeping, wanting something to eat, yet cautious of Rūmī. As he

witnessExcerpts.excerpt: وخرج الجرذ يبتغي ما يأكل وهو مع ذلك حذر يتلفّت وينظر فلمّا رأى السنّور مقتنصًا في الحبال فرح

profiles.description: The Rat Explains Not Cutting the Last Rope. witnessExcerpts.excerpt: وأنا قاطع حبائلك لوقتها غير أنّي تارك عقدة واحدة أرتهنك بها فلا أقطعها إلّا في الساعة التي أعرف أنّك عنّي فيها في شغل

profiles.title: The Cat and the Rat Escape
profiles.description: The Cat and the Rat Escape. Witness tradition (12): “When he cut the rest of his cords, and the cat knew that he had been delivered from the cords, he passed toward the tree, scampering, flabbergasted, and climbed it; the rat went into his den; and the huntsman grabbed his shredded cords and left feeling sad.”
openingHints: فلمّا أفلت عدا إلى الشجرة فصعدها ودخل الجرذ الحجر فأخد الصيّاد حبائله مقطّعة وانصرف

“When he cut the rest of his cords, and the cat knew that he

to the tree-to the huntsman’s amazement- and the rat entered some burrow. The huntsman

“When he got free, he ran to the tree and climbed it, the rat entered his burrow, and the huntsman grabbed his shredded cords and left disappointed.”

profiles.title: The Cat Is the Rat's Worst Enemy
profiles.description: The Cat Is the Rat's Worst Enemy. Witness tradition (10): You are an enemy unto me, and I am, likewise, an enemy unto you. How can friendship and amity work between us,

And no enemy is more harmful to me than you.
باردًا ولا شيء أضرّ لي عداوة منك

وليس من أعدائي عدوّ أضرّ لي منك
of my enemies there is none more harmful to me than you.

profiles.title: The Rat's Need for Friendship Has Gone
profiles.description: The Rat's Need for Friendship Has Gone. Witness tradition (8): while I know that you have no need except that of eating me You and I were compelled, by a need, to enter an agreement, and the matter which made you need me and which obliged me to you has passed. I fear, then, that in its passing is the return of the enmity between you and me.

profiles.title: The Cautious Weak Is Better Than Deluded Strong
profiles.description: The Cautious Weak Is Better Than Deluded Strong. Witness tradition (6): for I have learned that the weak person is closer to being safe from the strong, when he is wary of him and not misled by him, than the powerful who feels safe while he is misled by the weak and trusts him.
